questions_and_answers.question_text: Which two patterns are used to talk about the relationship of two things?
Write the Chinese question meaning "What is the relationship between the consulate and the embassy?"

answers.answer_text: "To relate to," "to have a bearing on," "to matter."

questions_and_answers.question_text: Which counter is used with shìqing?
Which two words may be used to join the two things being related?
What is the difference in level between a sīzhǎng and a kēzhǎng?

answers.answer_text: A sīzhǎng is a department chief; a kēzhǎng is a section chief.

articles.text:
Notes on Additional Required Vocabulary

8.  guānxi              relation, relationship, connection
9.  jiǎng huà           to speak, to talk; a speech
10. lǐngshìguǎn         consulate
11. shìqing (yíjiàn)    matter, business, affair
12. sīzhǎng             department chief
13. yǒu guānxi          to relate to, to have a bearing on, to matter

Yǒu guānxi: To talk about the relationship of two things, use

...gēn...yǒu guānxi   or   ...hé...yǒu guānxi.

Lǐngshìguǎn hé dàshǐguǎn         What is the relationship between
yǒu shénmeyàngde guānxi?         the consulate and the embassy?
